audio.text: Who should I talk to about changing my exam date?

options: The exam is on the fourteenth.
I changed my mind about the course.
Yes, you should ask quite soon.

why.en: "Who" → a person. A gives a date; C repeats "change" with another meaning; D answers with "Yes".
why.tr: "Who" → kişi. A tarih veriyor; C "change" kelimesini başka anlamda tekrar ediyor; D "Yes" ile cevap veriyor.
why.es: "Who" → una persona. A da una fecha; C repite "change" con otro significado; D responde "Yes".
